claims.content: To evaluate inventory performance and aging and gain visibility into currently available auction inventory.

goal.raw_text: To evaluate inventory performance and aging and gain visibility into currently available auction inventory.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer has access to the Auction Administration (“AA”) web-based application through the Main Menu page.
The Reports Menu includes the Inventory Performance & Aging Report.
Inventory for sale via auctions has been imported from JTV’s current inventory system, using inventory that meets particular criteria.
The Auctioneer selects the Inventory Performance & Aging Report from the Reports Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the Inventory Performance & Aging Report from the Reports Menu.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects the GO ▶ button for the Inventory Performance & Aging Report in the Reports Menu.
The Auctioneer uses the “search for auction items” search box, which provides wildcard (% or \*) capability.
The Auctioneer chooses between “Items currently online only” and “All sellable auction inventory” using radio button options; these buttons will not impact the results of the “Red status” columns.
The Auctioneer uses radio buttons to enable choosing between “Showing items with or without images” and “Showing items with or without a valid (sellable) location.”
The Auctioneer selects from the Group By scrolling list box.
The Inventory Performance & Aging Report evaluates inventory performance and aging.
The report includes product that is NOT part of available auction inventory.

At main flow step 2, the Auctioneer may choose the “Items currently online only” radio button option instead of “All sellable auction inventory”; these buttons will not impact the results of the “Red status” columns.

At main flow step 2, the Auctioneer may choose the “All sellable auction inventory” radio button option instead of “Items currently online only”; these buttons will not impact the results of the “Red status” columns.
At main flow step 3, the Auctioneer may use radio buttons to enable choosing between “Showing items with or without images”.
At main flow step 3, the Auctioneer may use radio buttons to enable choosing between “Showing items with or without a valid (sellable) location.”

At main flow step 4, the Auctioneer may select a Group By option from the Group By scrolling list box, which includes Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, Material Purity, Product Group, Brand, Inventory Realm (Red, White,), Inventory Aging Bucket, J/G Score, and Ring Size.
When the Auctioneer selects grouping options from the Grouping list box, the “Results” section will include any columns generated by user choices from the Grouping list box.
Visibility into currently available auction inventory has been gained through the Inventory Performance & Aging Report.
The report includes product that is NOT part of available auction inventory.
The Results section includes any columns generated by user choices from the Grouping list box.
